title: Belladonna's Chain
description: A pale woman with elaborate purple braided hair adorned with flowers and hanging bells stands centrally, wearing a blue and black corset dress while gripping a thick golden chain. To her left a blue horned demon holds the chain, while a purple onion-like creature holding a banana perches on her right shoulder.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a beautiful pale woman with intricate purple braided hair decorated with flowers, leaves, and many hanging silver bells. She wears a blue and black corseted dress and holds a heavy golden chain. A muscular blue demon with horns stands behind her left shoulder, while a small purple onion creature with a face holds a banana on her right. Chains, bells, and broken objects float around them against a solid black background.
